text: On 2026-06-09 Ollie completed a manual QA pass for the LUCID low-dose radiation biology replication effort. Results: 31 prior completed/triaged LUCID papers retained; 139 new candidates kept; 67 candidates demoted to backlog; 69 candidates excluded; curated master remains 100 papers = 31 completed/triaged plus 69 curated new candidates. QA report path: LUCID-replications/_LUCID100_ADMIN/LUCID100_QA_REPORT.md.
title: LUCID100 manual QA pass completed

text: Curated Wave 1 launch package is in rick-stevens-ai/replication-project at LUCID-replications/_LUCID100_WAVE1_LAUNCH_QA/. It contains 10 launch-ready replication brief folders, README.md, WAVE1_MANIFEST_QA.tsv, and per-paper PROGRESS.md stubs. Wave 1 papers include image-based DNA damage redistribution; mouse gut microbiome/metabolome after space-type radiation; intensity-modulated radiation fields and dose-rate effects; stochastic multicellular x-ray/DNA damage/misrejoining model; Daphnia low-level ionizing radiation epigenetic/transcriptional responses; zebrafish chronic low-dose liver exposure; E. coli low-dose source transcriptional response; IRI-DICE low-dose DSB hypothesis; cellular survival following DSBs; and biochemical DSB-repair model for mammalian G1/early S cells.
title: LUCID100 curated Wave 1 launch package

text: For LUCID100 work, UMP records are shared durable pointers, not the only source of truth. First recall UMP for project state, then inspect the replication-project repo files. Treat LUCID100_SOLID_MASTER_QA.tsv as the authoritative queue. Use LUCID100_QA_KEPT.tsv, LUCID100_QA_DEMOTED.tsv, and LUCID100_QA_EXCLUDED.tsv for curation rationale. For new work, create per-paper folders under LUCID-replications/, write README.md, PROGRESS.md, REPORT.md, artifact/data/code manifests, logs, figures, and verdicts. Final evaluative scoring must use rubric/LLM reading, not regex-only matching.
